title: Remote Control Project Kick-off Meeting
summary: The team introduced themselves and tested the digital whiteboard by drawing their favorite animals. Alan reviewed the project goals and financial targets, noting a manufacturing cost of 12.5 Euros and a retail target of 25 Euros with a 50 million Euro profit target. The group brainstormed ideas for a new remote control, focusing on integrated macro functionality, gaming controls, and an ergonomic handheld design. Alan concluded the meeting and agreed to summarize the notes ahead of their next session.
topics: Ergonomic and user interface design concepts
decisions: Target an affordable push-button design with integrated control and macro capabilities rather than an expensive touchscreen
Focus on an ergonomic, comfortable shape that conforms to the hand
